raw_html: [[Thundering]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Thundering]]:''' A thundering weapon creates a cacophonous roar when striking a successful critical hit. A thundering weapon deals an extra 1 to 8 points of sonic damage upon a successful critical hit with a weapon that has a x2 critical multiplier, an extra 2 to 16 for a x3 multiplier, and an extra 3 to 24 for x4 multiplier.
